readerCopy.body: Someone can say the thing everyone was thinking and leave the group arguing about the delivery instead of the information. When Mercury opposes Lilith, communication and refusal face each other directly, making tone easier to fight about than the uncomfortable fact underneath it. The speaker can be rude and still raise a valid issue. Delivery and substance become more useful when treated as separate questions rather than allowing one to erase the other.
